question: Is Stanford-ORB sufficient as the sole photorealism North Star for complete game scenes?
hypothesis: Keeping Stanford-ORB as the controlled renderer truth while adding a fixed end-to-end winter hero photo target will reject scene-level visual regressions that Stanford cannot observe, without weakening renderer correctness or runtime guards.

conditions.sceneTargetProvenance: AI-generated photorealistic target derived from the authored winter M3 composition; visual target only, not physical ground truth

authority.stanfordOrb: controlled renderer truth: geometry/camera/measured environment/BRDF/exposure on held-out real captures
authority.rule: A render change must not regress Stanford-ORB, must move the winter hero toward the reference, and must preserve the runtime guard.

acceptance.stanford: no held-out RealityGap regression beyond the existing tolerance
acceptance.winterHero: visual target distance must improve versus the parent baseline once the fixed hero capture metric is wired
acceptance.runtime: intermediate changes must not regress the measured parent throughput; final target is >=59 completed FPS and GPU p95 <=16.67 ms
